claim_text: On a 1024-dimensional Cryo-EM inference task, MDS substantially improves robustness to Gaussian noise contamination while maintaining performance in the well-specified regime (Figure 4).

scope.primary_metric: posterior RMSE against the true HSP90 state

preregistered_decision_rule.verified: The independent full-scale integrity checker passes; paired 95% bootstrap intervals for NPE-minus-MDS RMSE and predictive RFF distance are wholly above zero at every epsilon in {0.2,0.3,0.4,0.5}; mean relative reduction across those levels is at least 30% for RMSE and 5% for predictive RFF distance; and both MDS/NPE mean metric ratios at epsilon=0 are at most 1.10.
preregistered_decision_rule.falsified: Not assigned from a single stochastic retraining. A failure to meet the verification thresholds is BLOCKED and requires independent routes before any falsification claim.
preregistered_decision_rule.blocked: Any scale, integrity, frozen-model, reproducibility, improvement, substantial-effect, or clean-regime condition is unresolved.

substantial_effect_threshold_basis: The published Figure 4 shows roughly 45-60% RMSE reduction and approximately 8-13% predictive-MMD reduction at epsilon 0.2-0.5. Thresholds of 30% and 5% are conservative and fixed before the run.
negative_control: Disabled adaptation is reconstructed from the NPE rows and must exit nonzero because its paired gain is identically zero.
